storage_matching.note: LogIX at its own natural settings (no rank override); logix_bytes_per_example_measured is the REAL on-disk serialized size (log_*.mmap files / n_examples), not an analytical rank^2*4*n_layers estimate -- the earlier analytical version was wrong because it used the REQUESTED rank, not LoraLinear's actual min(requested_rank, in_features, out_features)-clamped rank. Rerun exp25/exp26/exp29 with --proj_dim traceprop_proj_dim_to_match for the storage-matched Traceprop-side comparison.

note: directly comparable to exp25/exp30's LoRAGradientLogger overhead numbers (same model, scope, batch/seq, interleaved-block timing methodology). default_random_init requests no covariance (LogIX's literal default); recommended_pca_init requests forward/backward covariance for PCA init (its authors' recommended LoRA setting) and times that pass separately in covariance_pass_s -- see logix_preconditioned in exp35 for the corresponding LDS-side comparison.
